remaining_selector_hooks: NPC loot must use original spawn/life/credit/resolved state and the engine's source-owned ground origin; NpcCombatMechanics currently has no explicit ordinary-loot ground-policy selector.
Preserve beginner-clue and member-only tertiary candidates with source family/ownership eligibility before enabling those full-target outcomes; the potion approval does not certify their selectors.
Ground death supplies require their source character/world-switch persistence and offline-paused clock, not a wall-clock expiry inferred solely from the policy numbers.
Engine-owned traversal, attack/recovery UI, engagement and initial setting selectors must consume the applied fields; this content task does not guess new shared field names.
